{{Quote|One precise shot at the middle pillar should do the job&hellip; [&hellip;] WHAT?|The trooper is startled by a creature while aligning the rocket launcher|<ref name="Waiting" />}}
A '''clone trooper''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He once served on a [[Unidentified planet (Post 473)|planet]], where he was designated to [[Post 473]] by his superiors. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] was tasked with destroying a bridge in order to hinder a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] convoy from crossing over and conquering a [[Unidentified mining colony (Post 473)|mining colony]]. The [[Missile/Legends|rockets]] for his [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] were stolen by a couple of the [[Unidentified bipedal species|native creatures]], forcing the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] to pursue them. As a result, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] went through a series of mishaps, but he was able to achieve his goal of destroying the bridge when he located the rockets near one of the the bridge's supports and shot them with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] as the droid forces were crossing over. As the clone attempted to pack his gear, the creatures stole the missile launcher, forcing him to pursue them once more.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've got to hurry. Only one hour before the convoy hits the bridge&hellip; Aw, no.|The trooper, before he crashes into an underground lake|<ref name="Waiting" />}}
[[File:Swcwav10p4.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The clone trooper notices that the rockets for his cannon are missing.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="databank" /> served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the Clone Wars,<ref name="Waiting" /> which was [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|initiated]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> At some point during the war, the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was designated to [[Post 473]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Post 473)|world]], where he was positioned atop a [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] overlooking a bridge and ordered by his [[Unidentified commander (Post 473)|commander]] to await the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], which was due to arrive in three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. With Republic reinforcements delayed, the lone trooper was the only resistance that the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] would face on their way to a nearby [[Unidentified mining colony (Post 473)|mining colony]]. He was tasked with destroying a bridge across the canyon, halting their advance.<ref name="Waiting" />

He began to adjust the alignment of his [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]], but the trooper was interrupted by one of the [[Unidentified bipedal species|local creatures]] stealing the [[Missile/Legends|rockets]] for the cannon. The creature took the rockets and darted into a nearby hole. The clone followed the creature and took back his rockets, only to find that the tunnel was not stable enough to support his weight. The creature fled, leaving the clone&mdash;still clutching the rockets&mdash;to fall into a subterranean [[Water/Legends|lake]], where he equipped a [[Rebreather/Legends|rebreather]] so that he could survive under the surface. As soon as he reacquired the rockets, the clone was attacked and swallowed by a massive underwater creature. However, he managed to shoot a hole in the creature's stomach and swim his way out. Freed from its belly, he was subsequently swept away by the underground current.<ref name="Waiting" />

Noticing that there was a waterfall up ahead, the clone attempted to cling onto a rock but was soon found by the same creature as before. The creature banged on the clone's [[Limb/Legends|hands]] with another rock, causing him to lose his grip. The trooper fell over the waterfall, only to land safely and find himself at the base of the bridge he was meant to destroy. He then saw that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] were in the middle of their crossing, and also located the rockets at the bottom of one of the bridge's support beams. Thinking quickly, the clone used his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and shot the rockets, causing them to detonate, resulting in the bridge exploding and collapsing, and destroying the droid [[Army/Legends|army]]. Wet and tired, the trooper returned to his previous station, ready to pack up the cannon and move on to his next assignment. However, the small creatures from before then darted in front of him, stealing the cannon and running away. The clone chased after the two creatures once more.<ref name="Waiting" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:WaitingBlueGuys.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The clone trooper chased the two blue creatures because they stole his equipment.]]
{{Quote|Give that back!"''<br />"''YAH! AH! AH! AH!|The clone chases the two creatures who stole his rocket launcher|<ref name="Waiting" />}}
The clone trooper expressed frustration when the two creatures made off with his equipment. Nevertheless, he was determined to find the rockets, and he found a way to complete his goal of destroying the bridge without using the cannon he originally intended to use. He wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|red]] markings and was equipped with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol and a rebreather. The clone had the same physical characteristics<ref name="Waiting" /> as Jango Fett;<ref name="databank" /> the trooper had black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that was parted by a line, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and tan skin.<ref name="Waiting" /> He also stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone trooper first appeared in the short story ''[[Waiting]]'', which was one of four stories in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 10|tenth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperbacks]]. He was created and drawn by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]].
